title: Telegram adapter and Pitgram spike
description: src/telegram/index.ts is type-only (a test pins zero runtime keys). Run the proof-of-concept list from docs/concept/pi-caretaker-high-level-concept-v3.md against a persistent Pi with pi-caretaker and Pitgram loaded: auth, silent background turn, explicit notify, reply context, sequential load, restart recovery. Record the verdict in docs/research/README.md. If Pitgram cannot keep background turns silent in the shared session, fall back to the smallest grammY bridge and write a new ADR rather than drifting.
author: Tomislav Zorcec

comments.text: Superseded, will not be built: the owner explicitly rejected Pitgram's interactive setup flow and chose ENV-only credentials with a direct grammY Bot instead (recorded in ADR-0007). The adapter is implemented under f8f1f597, landed as eef6e45. No Pitgram integration, no second Telegram path.
